fusions.name: Unfurled From Stillness
fusions.desc: Lashes out at every enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 26 damage, ignores their armour and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spent Warmth
fusions.desc: Spits a bolt of venom that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Basked and Ready
fusions.desc: Takes 2 seconds to cast, then increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed a Limb
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
